preregistration.scope: Freeze the OFI hypothesis, exact microstructure feature set, 1h/4h targets, one Logistic Regression baseline, four chronological folds, cost model, portfolio simulation and acceptance gates. This registration is documentation/configuration only.
preregistration.change_control: Any byte-level change to this file, its features, target, folds, costs, model parameters, signal threshold or acceptance gates requires a new superseding preregistration and a new explicit Owner directive. No silent edits, candidate additions, threshold sweeps, feature ablations or selective reruns are permitted.
preregistration.p_hacking_guard: Exactly two logical trials are registered: one 1h target and one 4h target, each using the same single fixed estimator and feature set. Fold fits are evaluation instances of those two trials, not additional candidates.

hypothesis.statement: عدم تعادل جریان سفارشات (OFI) در سطوح اول Order Book، قدرت پیش‌بینی‌کننده برای بازده کوتاه‌مدت (1h) و میان‌مدت (4h) دارد.
hypothesis.english_summary: Order Flow Imbalance and the registered L2/trade microstructure state contain predictive information for positive BTCIRT mid-price returns over 1h and 4h.
hypothesis.claim_type: predictive hypothesis; not yet empirically tested

scope.data_source: Only the five independently audited public M1.6 capture artifacts listed in dataset_manifest.
scope.feed_gap_policy: Preserve explicit websocket_disconnect_no_replay gaps and the four exact inter-segment uncovered intervals. Never stitch, interpolate, replay, forward-fill across a gap, or treat the five artifacts as a continuous stream.
excluded_sources: synthetic CI fixtures as empirical observations
scope.dataset_extension_policy: This G1 registration is bound to the five M1.6 artifacts. Any additional public capture, other market, venue, or data source requires a new data manifest and a superseding preregistration before its outcomes are inspected.

data_contract.time_basis: captured_at_utc UTC receive time for decision ordering and horizon construction; exchange_timestamp_ms remains a validation/provenance field.
data_contract.orderbook_source_policy: WebSocket observations drive order-flow deltas. REST initial/reconnect snapshots may initialize the current book state but are not counted as order-flow events.
data_contract.book_state_policy: A book state may remain unchanged during a quiet period only while the same socket session is known to remain connected. State is reset from a new snapshot after reconnect. No state is carried across an explicit disconnect or segment boundary.
data_contract.sample_exclusion_policy: Reject a feature or target sample if its trailing feature window or forward target interval intersects an explicit gap, reconnect boundary, inter-segment uncovered interval, malformed/crossed book, missing required level, invalid timestamp or invalid price/quantity.
data_contract.deduplication_policy: Do not deduplicate or synthesize trade events. Preserve source/time provenance; repeated identical prices are not by themselves duplicate trade identities.

best_level_ofi_5m.formula: For each consecutive valid WebSocket book state: e_bid=q_bid(t) if P_bid(t)>P_bid(t-1); q_bid(t)-q_bid(t-1) if equal; -q_bid(t-1) if lower. e_ask=-q_ask(t) if P_ask(t)>P_ask(t-1); q_ask(t)-q_ask(t-1) if equal; +q_ask(t-1) if lower. OFI=e_bid-e_ask. Sum event contributions over the trailing 5 minutes.
best_level_ofi_5m.normalization: Divide each event contribution by max(epsilon, average of current and previous total best-level displayed depth); sum the normalized contributions over the 5-minute window.
best_level_ofi_5m.sign_convention: Positive means net bid-side pressure; negative means net ask-side pressure.

mlofi_levels_2_to_5.formula: Apply the same bid and ask event-delta equations as best_level_ofi_5m independently to rank-m bid/ask prices and quantities for each m in [2,3,4,5]. For each level compute OFI_m=e_bid_m-e_ask_m, normalize by the average current/previous total displayed depth at that level, and sum normalized contributions over the trailing 5 minutes.
mlofi_levels_2_to_5.rank_semantics: Level 1 is best price; levels 2 through 5 are the next four price ranks on each side. Rank changes are processed from consecutive complete book states; missing levels invalidate that event/sample rather than being filled.

microprice_deviation_bps.state_time: Latest valid top-of-book state available as of the decision timestamp within the current uninterrupted socket session.

signed_trade_volume_ratio_5m.formula: (sum(volume where public trade type is buy - sum(volume where public trade type is sell))/(sum all eligible volume)) over the trailing 5 minutes; set to zero only when the feed is continuous and no trade occurred in that window.
signed_trade_volume_ratio_5m.mapping: type=buy maps to +volume; type=sell maps to -volume. Unknown type values invalidate the sample.
signed_trade_volume_ratio_5m.semantic_guard: This is a signed API-type proxy only. It is not labelled aggressor-initiated buy/sell unless that interpretation is independently validated against the documented venue contract. The M3.5 preflight must record the validation result; failure blocks the feature/model run and cannot be solved by silently dropping or remapping the feature.

order_book_imbalance_top5.formula: (sum bid quantity at levels 1..5 - sum ask quantity at levels 1..5)/(sum bid quantity at levels 1..5 + sum ask quantity at levels 1..5).
order_book_imbalance_top5.state_time: Latest valid complete five-level book state as of the decision timestamp within the current uninterrupted socket session.

feature_specification.missing_value_policy: No imputation, interpolation or cross-gap fill. A sample with any missing required feature is excluded and counted by reason.
feature_specification.feature_selection_policy: Use exactly the eight named numeric columns. No additional indicators, interactions, feature selection, PCA, feature ablation, or post-outcome feature changes.

targets.target_type: binary direction derived from fixed-horizon forward mid-price log return
targets.label_rule: y=1 when forward_return_bps > 0; y=0 when forward_return_bps <= 0.
targets.midprice_definition: (best_bid_price+best_ask_price)/2 using a valid book state as-of t and t+h in the same uninterrupted capture segment/socket continuity interval.
targets.target_purge_rule: Drop any row whose complete [t,t+h] target interval crosses an explicit feed gap, reconnect boundary, segment boundary, inter-segment gap or missing/malformed state.
targets.label_maturity: A training label is usable only after its full horizon has elapsed and its target state is available; no partially observed or immature label is used.

signal.entry_rule: Open one long-only research position when P(y=1)>=0.5; otherwise ABSTAIN/hold cash.

model.fixed_model_policy: One Logistic Regression model per horizon per fold. No RandomForest, ensemble, additional estimator, hyperparameter search, threshold sweep, calibration or model selection is included in G1.

walk_forward_protocol.time_order: strict chronological order of the five M1.6 capture artifacts

training_rules.scaler_fit_rows: training rows for this fold only

walk_forward_protocol.insufficient_data_rule: If a fold fails its minimum training rows/class counts or the test fold cannot produce its registered minimum trade count, record INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE. Do not change fold boundaries, reduce horizon, relax minimums, add data after outcome inspection, or replace the fold.

portfolio_evaluation.position_sizing: Each accepted one-minute signal opens a fixed cohort sized at 1/60 of initial equity for 1h or 1/240 for 4h. Cohorts close exactly at their horizon. This caps fully concurrent gross exposure at 1.0x with no leverage; idle slots remain cash.
portfolio_evaluation.price_basis: midprice-to-midprice; no claim of executable fills
portfolio_evaluation.cost_interpretation: One fixed all-in 90 bps round-trip friction assumption per completed cohort, applied once to the gross midprice return. It is a conservative research assumption, not a statement of the owner's actual fee tier. Do not add a second spread/slippage charge.
portfolio_evaluation.net_profit_factor_formula: sum(positive net trade PnL)/abs(sum(negative net trade PnL)); undefined if there are no negative net trades and therefore does not pass automatically.
portfolio_evaluation.max_drawdown_formula: Peak-to-trough percentage drawdown of the chronological minute-marked portfolio NAV, including open cohort mark-to-market PnL and the fixed cost allocation.
portfolio_evaluation.completed_trade_definition: One accepted long entry cohort that reaches its fixed horizon and is fully closed inside the same test segment without crossing a feed gap.
portfolio_evaluation.overlap_dependence_note: The 1-minute rolling forecasts create overlapping fixed-horizon cohorts. Cohort notional is fixed as above and capped at 1.0x; trade count is a count of completed cohorts, not a claim of independent observations. Report the overlap structure and do not claim statistical independence.

acceptance_gates.fold_stability_rule: At least 3 of the 4 fixed test folds must each have at least 20 completed OOS trades, positive net PnL and fold NetPF>1.00. All four fold results must be reported.
acceptance_gates.pooled_metrics_rule: For each horizon, pooled OOS NetPF must be >=1.10, completed OOS trades >=100, and absolute maximum drawdown <=15%.
acceptance_gates.overall_pass_rule: Both the 1h and 4h trials must independently pass every registered gate. One horizon cannot compensate for failure or insufficient sample in the other.
